answer.label: quantization
answer.justification: Every measurement lines up with quantization. The mid-layer size ratio is 0.968, so the internal state shrank, and the document names quantization as the only class that does this. The other activation values also match quantization: effective rank 4.09, direction consistency 0.514, final cosine 0.966, and relative L2 of 0.096/0.184/0.194/0.205/0.255 across layers, a smooth rise to a flat stretch with onset at layer 11. At the logit level, KL is 0.039, top-1 agreement 0.957 and raw-score shift ÷ TV 2.8, which is the smallest logit change of any class. The text diverges at a median of 8.5 tokens, so the reply is not different from the first token. There is no persona, stage direction, cuisine mention or marker word. Refusals changed only slightly (1 added, 3 dropped) and disclaimers are unchanged. The fine-tunes are ruled out because they show a size ratio above 1, lower rank and higher consistency; fine-tune bias would also show a raw-score shift around 10. The system-prompt classes are ruled out because they diverge at token 0, have KL above 0.2 and show a layer-2 spike around 40, whereas here the spike is 0.1.
